Transactional email: single, batch and templated messages from one Postmark server.

## API key

1. Sign in to [Postmark](https://account.postmarkapp.com) and open the server the app sends from.
2. Open the server's **API Tokens** tab.
3. Copy a **Server API token**. Never the Account API token.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add postmark
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  postmark: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Postmark's [API](https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/overview) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. Use `"write"` if the app changes things. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show postmark` shows the key as set.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Postmark).
